Phase 68 implemented at e83da41 (3 commits: bf2e995 server, 89bd1dd front end, e83da41 what the live look found + docs). gate: see entry @ e83da41.

What / where
- tagteam/cockpit_api.py: status_facts(root) — the headline's inputs from reads that never open the DB (state file, config, in-flight + slot_owner_gone, pause marker, watcher_status, beat_view/last_event, new watcher.last_dispatch, beat.text); inflight_liveness() — starting | no-child | running | finishing | unknown | lost, 'lost' only on a definitively gone OWNER (or a legacy marker's confirmed-dead child); turn_delivered(); headline(facts, launch) — the approved first-match table; now_payload() now takes these facts from status_facts() and adds 'headline' (its one DB-derived input, the pending launch, is passed in). Existing now keys unchanged; inflight gains 'liveness'.
- tagteam/watchlog.py: watch status prints 'now: <headline> · <age>' first and is built from status_facts() only; read(..., include_info=False) drops info BEFORE taking the newest n and folds runs of the same (kind, msg, seq) into repeat/last_ts.
- tagteam/server.py: /api/watcher/events takes chatter=0|1 and FIXES A 3.14.5 BUG OF MINE: it indexed _qs()'s already-scalar value, so n=200 meant 2 and n=37 meant 3 (Phase 67's test used n=5).
- tagteam/data/web/cockpit.{html,js,css}: chip-owed / chip-inflight / chip-paused / chip-watcher removed; a full-width turn bar (<button aria-expanded aria-controls>) presenting n.headline with one locally ticking age; the watcher drawer (facts, Start/Stop moved here, why the page cannot run turns — START.headless.errors, also in the notify-mode confirm body — or 'agents are in their terminals', story history with 'show everything', follow-only-at-bottom + 'new events' cue, Esc, remembered in localStorage). New JS is one banner-delimited slice, createElement/textContent only.

Approval notes: turn_delivered() accepts only a terminal watcher's 'sent' with a non-null matching seq (notify and headless 'sent' never count; None never matches None); a pause after delivery reads '… has its turn; further hand-offs are held'; liveness 'unknown' reads as plain working, never 'finishing'.

Guards changed ON PURPOSE (tests/test_cockpit_activity.py), none deleted to get green: (1) required-id list: chip-owed, chip-inflight, chip-watcher out; turn-bar, turn-text, turn-age, watcher-drawer, wd-facts, wd-rows, wd-all, wd-new, btn-watcher, chip-cycle in; the four pill ids are now asserted ABSENT from html and js; bar must be a button with aria-expanded/aria-controls, in its own row, before the drawer, before Needs-you. (2) UX-words guard: 'is working' / 'waiting on' / 'watcher: on|off' no longer live in the JS — it now generates the real sentences from capi.headline over a product of facts and asserts the plain words are there and engine words (in flight, dispatch, slot, marker, seq, pid…) are not. (3) the fitLanes slice end-marker moved from the deleted renderOwedChip to the watcher-button handler. Also tests/test_watchlog.py: watch status expectations gain the first line; beat gains 'text'.

Tests: test_cockpit_api — liveness over markers written by the real slot writers (live gate owner + pid None, cycle and panel before spawn → running → dead child under live owner, dead owner, legacy, unreadable identity, unknown), the full headline table, priorities, the enumerated owed-turn product (3,600 combinations: never idle, agent always named, age always set), text never carries an age, status_facts with db.connect patched to fail; test_watchlog — watch status on a DB-less project with and without TAGTEAM_READ_ONLY leaves the tree byte-identical, story-mode filtering/folding, endpoint n=37/200 and chatter=0; test_cockpit_activity — six node-run tests of the new slice. Focused run of the eight front-end/API files: 405 passed.

Seen, not assumed (criterion 7; table + what each shot shows in the phase doc; screenshots under git-ignored .playwright-mcp/): this repo under its iTerm2 watcher with the terminals note; and in a scratch project: watcher-off, the watcher started from the drawer, 'codex is reviewing' live in the reviewer's colour, the automatic hand-off to the lead, approved with history, and a REAL stalled state (scratch watcher SIGSTOP-ped, new turn owed → red 'Stalled…', same sentence from watch status). The live look is what found five defects the green unit tests had not (cut-off sentence, the n bug, chatter burying the story, 48 identical turn lines per pre-check, 'working on the plan' while implementing) — all fixed and pinned by tests.

Deviation: while open, the drawer re-reads /api/now + events every 5 s (plan: the page's 30 s tick) because 'last look: 7s ago' must not sit frozen. Plan said chatter is hidden client-side; it is filtered server-side because the window is counted there.

NOT verified / not seen: 'waiting' under a terminal watcher with a turn owed (this repo was 'done' while I looked — it is on screen now, while you hold this submission), needs-you, turn-lost, paused, launching (table tests only); the start-impl verb fix was made after its screenshot and is verified by test only. Left for Phase 68b and recorded in docs/cockpit-issues.md: Needs-you stays calm while the bar says Stalled; the reviewer lane still says 'the watcher will start it'.

GATE: PASS | scope 12 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (2270 passed, 5 skipped, 7m39s)
checked: HEAD e83da41

Reviewed e83da41 against the approved plan, including headline/status_facts, liveness and delivery semantics, frontend integration, guard changes, and the approved-with-history screenshot. Two reproduced history defects need correction:

1. tagteam/watchlog.py:263-268 chooses whether to read .1 using the pre-collapse record count. With n=200, 201 identical tagged events in the live file, and an older distinct sent event retained in .1, story mode returns just one folded row and never reads the older event. Reproduced with _records supplying these two generations: read(..., 200, include_info=False) returned only {kind: turn, repeat: 201}. Determine the needed history after folding (including runs spanning the boundary), or combine the two bounded generations before filtering/folding/taking n. Add coverage for a live run larger than n, a retained match in .1, and a run crossing the rotation boundary. The byte bound already makes the two-generation scan finite.

2. cockpit.js:311-330 detects new events by list length and preserves only pixel scrollTop. The API returns a rolling 200-row window: at capacity every new event leaves the length unchanged, so the cue never appears, and keeping the same pixel offset shifts the reader to a different event when the oldest row drops out. A folded row's repeat/last_ts can also change with no length change. Reproduced through the existing _run_p68 Node harness: render 200 events, scroll back, replace event 0 with new event 200; newEventCueHidden remains True. Detect new/updated history using event identity/content, preserve the visible event anchor and offset while it remains retained, and keep the unread cue until the reader follows/clicks it (currently even an unchanged next refresh clears it). Add capped-window, folded-update, repeated-identical-refresh, and anchor-preservation tests. The existing test that expects the cue to vanish on the next unchanged refresh should be revised deliberately.

The main headline and DB-free CLI approach address the plan findings and approval notes. Accepted scope adjustments: the multi-digit n parsing fix is correct for _qs's scalar values; server-side filtering before counting is needed to retain useful history; folding repeated story rows is sensible with the correction above. Five-second refresh while open is a reasonable scoped change. Existing keys and the no-UI-work-in-lanes boundary are preserved.

Verification: reviewer tests/test_cockpit_api.py + tests/test_cockpit_activity.py + tests/test_watchlog.py: 204 passed. git diff --check a7dae2b..HEAD clean. Gate PASS @ e83da41: 2270 passed, 5 skipped, accepted without rerunning the suite. Reviewer inspected .playwright-mcp/p68-6-approved-with-history.png; the header/drawer hierarchy is clear. Lead's disclosed unobserved states and the post-screenshot verb change remain accurately limited to automated coverage; retain those distinctions in closeout. No interjections present.

Both r1 findings fixed at 3f557f4. gate: see entry @ 3f557f4.

1. Story history (tagteam/watchlog.py read): story mode no longer decides on the pre-fold count. It reads both bounded generations, filters info, folds — a run may straddle the rotation — and applies n LAST. The unfolded listing is unchanged (newest n raw lines, .1 only when the live file is short). Regression test_story_history_is_sized_after_folding_and_spans_the_rotation builds it with the real Sink and a real rotation: an older 'sent' left only in .1, a run of 203 identical 'turn' lines beginning in .1 and ending in the live file (201 of them live, > n) → [('sent', 1), ('turn', 2, repeat 203)] with ts < last_ts; n=1 returns the newest row; read(200) raw still returns 200 and read(500) 204.

2. Drawer (cockpit.js renderDrawerRows): news is detected by content signature (ts|kind|seq|msg + repeat + last_ts), never by length; the reader is anchored to the first visible EVENT plus the offset into it (topAnchor) and restored to that event after the re-render, staying put if it has left the window; DRAWER.unread is sticky — set when content changed while scrolled back, cleared only by reaching the bottom (scroll listener) or clicking the cue — and an unchanged refresh no longer clears it. Toggling 'show everything' is a different list, not news. The DOM stub gained a browser-like layout (100px rows: offsetTop / offsetHeight / scrollHeight). Tests: follows only at the bottom (now asserting the anchored event, 'e1+40'); a full 200-row window rolling by one keeps length 200, moves scrollTop 5040 → 4940 and the reader stays on e50+40, cue shown; the anchor leaving the window stays put; sticky cue across identical refreshes; a folded row growing in place (repeat 1 → 2, same length) is news; reaching the bottom clears it. The earlier expectation that the cue vanishes on the next unchanged refresh is revised on purpose.

All 4 regressions fail on the r1 code (checked by restoring cockpit.js and watchlog.py from e83da41 and running them).

Also in this round, disclosed: the nit I reported after the r1 submission — this repo's bar read 'its turn was sent to its terminal · 7m' seconds after a 7½-minute pre-check, because the age counted from the submission. A DELIVERED turn's age now counts from the dispatch record (age_of 'sent'), in the waiting and watcher-off rows; undelivered rows keep the owed age; the amber threshold applies to whichever age is shown. Test added; the enumerated product test admits the new age_of.

Focused: test_watchlog + test_cockpit_api + test_cockpit_activity = 208 passed. No new browser session this round — the drawer scroll behaviour is verified under the node harness only, not by hand in a browser. Closeout will keep the r1 distinctions: needs-you, turn-lost, paused, launching and the start-impl verb are covered by tests only.

GATE: PASS | scope 12 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (2274 passed, 5 skipped, 7m40s)
checked: HEAD 3f557f4

Reviewed 3f557f4. The two-generation filter/fold/limit fix is correct, including runs crossing the rotation boundary. Content-based news detection and sticky unread state address the prior cue defect. The disclosed delivered-age adjustment is reasonable.

One remaining defect in the scroll-anchor fix: topAnchor compares row.offsetTop with box.scrollTop, but those values have different origins under the shipped CSS. .wd-history is position:relative; .wd-rows is not positioned, so each .wd-row.offsetParent is .wd-history. Its offset includes the history heading and box placement, whereas scrollTop starts inside .wd-rows. The Node layout stub assumes row offsets start at the scroll box and therefore misses this.

Reproduced in real headless Chromium using the shipped cockpit.css and the unchanged Phase 68 JS slice in an isolated page with the actual wd-history / wd-head / wd-rows nesting: render events 0..199, set box.scrollTop=30, then render 1..200. Before refresh the first visible event is 1, but topAnchor returns event 0 with delta 0 and offsetParent is wd-history. Event 0 drops out, so the fallback keeps scrollTop=30 and event 2 becomes first visible. Event 1 remains retained but the reader loses it.

Normalize row positions to the scroll container (for example via bounding rectangles plus scrollTop/clientTop), or establish an appropriate positioned scroll container and account for its padding. Add a real-layout regression with the heading above the box and variable/wrapped row heights; confirm that event 1 and its intra-row offset remain fixed when event 0 drops out. The simplified offsetTop stub alone is insufficient evidence for this behavior.

Verification: reviewer focused test_watchlog + test_cockpit_api + test_cockpit_activity: 208 passed; git diff --check e83da41..HEAD clean. Gate PASS @ 3f557f4: 2274 passed, 5 skipped; accepted without full-suite rerun. Browser reproduction used cached Chromium headless shell 1243 with an isolated in-memory page, no project or live-app mutations. No other new findings or interjections.

r2 finding fixed at 1132e1f. gate: see entry @ 1132e1f.

The defect was exactly where I had said the evidence was thin ('scrolling verified under the node harness only'): topAnchor compared row.offsetTop with box.scrollTop, and under the shipped CSS a row's offsetParent is .wd-history, not the scroll box.

Fix (cockpit.js): rowTopIn(box, row) = row.getBoundingClientRect().top − box.getBoundingClientRect().top − box.clientTop + box.scrollTop — the scroll container's own coordinates, independent of which ancestor is positioned, and it accounts for the box's border; padding is inside that coordinate space on both sides of the comparison. topAnchor uses it (and the row's measured height), and the restore sets scrollTop = rowTopIn(anchorRow) + delta. No CSS change.

Real-layout regression, as asked: TestDrawerScrollInARealBrowser runs the UNCHANGED Phase 68 slice in headless Chromium with the shipped cockpit.css and the shipped <header> markup (the actual wd-history / wd-head / wd-rows nesting, heading above the box), no new dependency — a temp page + '--dump-dom', on a Chromium from the Playwright cache, a Chrome install, PATH, or TAGTEAM_TEST_CHROME; skipped when none exists (same policy as the node tests). Rows have variable, wrapped heights (every third message wraps; asserted h1 > 2×h0). Scenario = yours: render 0..199, scrollTop = h0 + 30, render 1..200. Asserts, measured independently of the code under test by bounding rects: the trap is real (row.offsetParent is .wd-history, offsetTop of row 0 > 0); before = event 1 at 30 − paddingTop px in; topAnchor returns event 1 with that delta; after = the same event at the same offset; an unchanged refresh does not move it; scrollTop == 30; 200 rows; the cue is shown. On the r2 code it fails with anchor {seq: 0, delta: 15} — your reproduction.

The node stub no longer pretends: its rows are laid out through getBoundingClientRect in a box that sits 57px down the page with a 1px border, and offsetTop THROWS ('relative to the offsetParent, not the scroll box'), so that mistake cannot come back unnoticed there either.

Focused: test_cockpit_activity + test_watchlog + test_cockpit_api = 209 passed (the Chromium test ran, 0.8 s, chrome-headless-shell 1243). Nothing else changed since 3f557f4. CI note: the Chromium test will run wherever a Chrome is on PATH (the Ubuntu runners have one) and is launched with --no-sandbox; it is skipped on Windows.

GATE: PASS | scope 12 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (2275 passed, 5 skipped, 7m49s)
checked: HEAD 1132e1f

Approved implementation at 1132e1f. The remaining scroll-anchor finding is fixed: rowTopIn uses bounding rectangles, clientTop and scrollTop to measure and restore the anchor in the scroll container's coordinates, independent of the positioned ancestor. The Chromium regression exercises the shipped header/CSS, confirms the old offsetParent trap, uses variable wrapped heights, and independently verifies the same event and intra-row offset survive a rolling-window update and an unchanged refresh. The revised Node stub also no longer masks the coordinate mismatch.

Verification: reviewer tests/test_cockpit_activity.py: 67 passed, including the real Chromium regression (no skips). git diff --check 3f557f4..HEAD clean. Gate PASS @ 1132e1f: 2275 passed, 5 skipped; accepted without rerunning the suite. Prior accepted history-folding, unread-cue, and delivered-age fixes stand. No outstanding findings or interjections.

Closeout should retain the previously disclosed visual-verification limits for headline states exercised only by table tests. The scroll behavior now has real-browser regression evidence; it is no longer limited to the Node model. Existing lane/Needs-you wording issues remain the separately recorded Phase 68b work.
